+def _is_child_path(path, root, link_path=None):

+    root = os.path.realpath(root)
+    path = os.path.realpath(path)
+    separator = to_bytes(os.path.sep) if isinstance(root, bytes) else os.path.sep
+    return path == root or path.startswith(root.rstrip(separator) + separator)

+def test_extract_unsafe_symlink_as_file(tmp_path_factory):
+    temp_dir = to_bytes(tmp_path_factory.mktemp('unsafe link tar'))
+    tar_path = os.path.join(temp_dir, b'links.tar.gz')
+    with tarfile.open(tar_path, 'w:gz') as tar_obj:
+        data = b'safe copied content'
+        source = tarfile.TarInfo('../outside')
+        source.size = len(data)
+        tar_obj.addfile(source, BytesIO(data))
+        link = tarfile.TarInfo('unsafe')
+        link.type = tarfile.SYMTYPE
+        link.linkname = '../outside'
+        tar_obj.addfile(link)
+        directory_link = tarfile.TarInfo('unsafe-dir')
+        directory_link.type = tarfile.SYMTYPE
+        directory_link.linkname = '../outside-dir'
+        tar_obj.addfile(directory_link)
+
+    output = os.path.join(temp_dir, b'installed')
+    with tarfile.open(tar_path, 'r') as tar_obj:
+        collection._extract_tar_file(tar_obj, 'unsafe', output, temp_dir, sha256(data).hexdigest())
+        collection._extract_tar_dir(tar_obj, 'unsafe-dir', output)
+    assert not os.path.islink(os.path.join(output, b'unsafe'))
+    with open(os.path.join(output, b'unsafe'), 'rb') as file_obj:

+    assert not os.path.islink(os.path.join(output, b'unsafe-dir'))
